messages:
maria: Hey team — need eyes on #PR-18345, trying to land before the region maintenance window. CI is flaking on macos-integration. Is there a short rebase window or can we do a staggered landing? :eyes:
kevin: Link? I can try a rebase and rerun the mac job. if it's only mac we might be able to land in stages.
kevin: https://git.company/pr/18345
dev-bot: CI status: macos-integration — flaky (3/5), linux-matrix — passing, integration-e2e — passing. Last run: 1729999800
oliver: If mac keeps failing, consider landing the non-platform-specific pieces first (split if possible). Or we can do a canary on dedicated capacity.
maria: It's mostly a refactor + a small change to the GPU scheduler config. The scheduler change touches platform init, so mac job flags it intermittently. I can isolate the refactor into a follow-up, but that'll take ~30m.
jen: Quick option: cherry-pick the refactor into a smaller PR and land it now. Then rebase this one onto that. Less risky before maintenance.
sre-ops: Maintenance window is 2024-06-10 03:30–04:30 UTC. We recommend no large merges during that hour. We can allow staged merges up to 30m before the window.
kevin: OK. I can rebase and queue a rerun now. If mac fails again, I'll trigger a video job on a mac-mini runner (lower flake).
kevin: Rebase commands I used:
```
# fetch and rebase onto main
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
# force-push to trigger CI
git push --force-with-lease origin HEAD:refs/heads/pr-18345
```
maria: thanks — I'll open a tiny PR for the refactor and mark it as high-priority.
jen: ping me when the small PR is up, I can review quickly. :thumbsup:
oliver: If we do staggered landing, recommend this order: 1) refactor PR (no infra touches), 2) scheduler change behind feature flag, 3) remove flag in a follow-up. That avoids rollback during maintenance.
sre-ops: Also note: if you need a manual canary before maintenance, DM us and we can reserve a slot on dedicated for a 15m canary.
kevin: rerun triggered — mac job now queued (1729999920).
dev-bot: CI update: macos-integration rerun started (job id 99123).
maria: opened https://git.company/pr/18346 (refactor only). tagging @jen for review.
jen: Reviewing now, will aim to merge within 20 min.
maria: If jen merges quickly, I'll rebase PR-18345 and tag for expedited merge 15m before maintenance.
kevin: mac job finished: flaky fail. Logs show timeout in remote file fetch. I'll add a small retry in the test harness and rerun.
kevin: quick fix pushed to pr branch, rerun queued.
dev-bot: CI update: macos-integration rerun finished — passing.
maria: great. rebase underway.
maria: rebase done and pushed, marking this for merge with canary enabled.
sre-ops: Can confirm canary slot reserved 15m before maintenance (03:15 UTC). Good luck.
jen: Merged PR-18346 (refactor).
kevin: all green on PR-18345 now. I'll queue merge just before the canary slot.
maria: thank you everyone — will follow through and post final status after merge. :rocket:
